Red Lobster Happy Hour: Overview

The Red Lobster Happy Hour is the perfect time to enjoy delicious seafood dishes at discounted prices. Whether you’re heading out for an after-work drink special, or simply craving their signature shrimp and lobster dishes, the happy hour specials will not disappoint. Red Lobster’s Happy Hour has been thoughtfully curated to offer some of their best items at wallet-friendly prices. You’ll find everything from crispy calamari to shrimp scampi, paired with discounted drinks like well drinks, draft beers, and house wines.

Red Lobster Happy Hour Menu

Red Lobster’s happy hour menu offers a mix of appetizers, drinks, and seafood that are sure to delight anyone. Here’s a look at the most popular items on the Red Lobster Happy Hour menu:

Appetizers and Snacks

Red Lobster’s happy hour menu includes several amazing appetizers to kick-start your meal:

  • Crispy Calamari: Lightly breaded and served with a side of spicy marinara sauce.
  • Buffalo Chicken Wings: Crispy wings tossed in a tangy buffalo sauce.
  • Shrimp Tacos: Soft tortillas filled with tender shrimp, lettuce, and a zesty sauce.
  • Wood-Grilled Lobster Pizza: A delicious pizza topped with succulent lobster meat and melted cheese.

Seafood Dishes

The happy hour specials also feature some of the most popular seafood items, including:

  • Endless Shrimp: A fan favorite that allows you to enjoy as much shrimp as you like, prepared in different styles.
  • Shrimp Scampi: A classic dish featuring shrimp cooked in a garlic butter sauce.
  • Sweet Chili Shrimp: Perfectly cooked shrimp tossed in a sweet and spicy chili sauce.

Red Lobster Happy Hour Times

Wondering when you can enjoy these incredible deals? The Red Lobster Happy Hour time typically runs from Monday through Friday, from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM, though hours may vary depending on the location.

Day Happy Hour Time
Monday 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Tuesday 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Wednesday 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Thursday 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Friday 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM

Pro Tip: Some locations also offer a late-night happy hour for those who want to grab a bite or drink after dinner.

Red Lobster Drink Specials

Red Lobster’s Happy Hour isn’t just about seafood; their drink specials are a great way to unwind after a long day. The Happy Hour menu includes discounted drinks like:

  • House Wines: A selection of white and red wines available at discounted prices.
  • Draft Beers: Enjoy a cold beer from the tap, with several varieties available.
  • Well Drinks: Cocktails made with Smirnoff Vodka, New Amsterdam Gin, Bacardi, and more.
  • Specialty Cocktails: Don’t forget to try the Sauza Gold Tequila margaritas or a Bacardi Silver Rum mojito!

Appetizers You Can’t Miss During Happy Hour

At Red Lobster, appetizers are one of the highlights of their happy hour menu. Some of the best happy hour appetizers include:

1. Crispy Calamari

The crispy calamari is served with a side of spicy marinara and is a must-try for calamari lovers.

2. Buffalo Chicken Wings

For those who love spicy food, the buffalo chicken wings are tossed in a zesty sauce that packs a punch.

3. Shrimp Cocktail

This classic appetizer is refreshing and delicious, featuring fresh shrimp served with a tangy cocktail sauce.

What Makes Red Lobster’s Happy Hour Special?

What sets the Red Lobster Happy Hour apart from other restaurant deals is the combination of great seafood and unbeatable prices. Whether it’s the endless shrimp or the unique drink offerings, the variety and quality of food offered during happy hour make it a great deal.

Benefits of Red Lobster Happy Hour

  • Discounted prices on premium seafood dishes.
  • Drink specials including draft beers, house wines, and well drinks.
  • A variety of appetizers and shrimp dishes available at a fraction of the regular price.
  • Special deals available Monday through Friday, offering consistent value.

Red Lobster Locations Offering Happy Hour

Almost all Red Lobster locations across the country offer happy hour deals. To find the nearest Red Lobster and check their happy hour times, visit their official website or use their restaurant locator. This will help you ensure that the Red Lobster near you is participating in the happy hour specials.

Happy Hour at Red Lobster: Pricing Breakdown

The Red Lobster Happy Hour menu is designed to offer great value, with discounts on food and drinks. Here’s a quick breakdown of some of the best-priced items:

  • House Wines: Starting at $5.00 per glass.
  • Draft Beers: Available for $4.50.
  • Well Drinks: Cocktails priced around $5.00 – $6.00.
  • Appetizers: Most appetizers, including calamari, shrimp tacos, and buffalo chicken wings, are available between $6.99 and $9.99.

Best Time to Enjoy Happy Hour at Red Lobster

If you’re looking to get the best deals, we recommend visiting during weekdays between 3:00 PM and 6:00 PM. These hours are perfect for enjoying a post-work meal or catching up with friends over drinks.

Monday Through Friday Specials

The weekday happy hour specials are perfect for those looking for a great way to unwind. The happy hour deals at Red Lobster are available from Monday to Friday, offering everything from discounted shrimp dishes to refreshing cocktails.

FAQs About Red Lobster Happy Hour

1. What time does Red Lobster’s Happy Hour start?

The happy hour typically runs from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

2. Are there drink specials during Red Lobster Happy Hour?

Yes, house wines, draft beers, and well drinks are all part of the drink specials.

3. Is there an endless shrimp option available during Happy Hour?

Yes, you can enjoy endless shrimp for $17.99.

4. Does every Red Lobster location offer Happy Hour?

Most Red Lobster locations participate, but it’s best to check with your nearest restaurant.

5. Can I enjoy Happy Hour deals on weekends?

Some locations may offer weekend specials, but generally, the happy hour is Monday through Friday.

6. Are there any food and drink pairings recommended during Happy Hour?

We recommend pairing crispy calamari or shrimp tacos with a glass of house wine or a draft beer.

Conclusion

In conclusion, Red Lobster’s Happy Hour is a fantastic opportunity to enjoy great seafood at discounted prices. Whether you’re in the mood for shrimp, lobster, or a refreshing cocktail, the Red Lobster Happy Hour has you covered. With affordable pricing and a wide selection of menu items, you can’t go wrong by visiting your nearest Red Lobster during happy hour!
